articles.title: Delivering the Sendai Framework: An ASEAN approach to inclusive disaster and climate resilience
articles.description: This side event will explore key elements of an ASEAN approach to accelerate the implementation of the Sendai Framework, drawing on national and regional experiences to identify priorities for a future global disaster risk reduction agenda.

articles.title: Webinar Series: Artificial Intelligence in Disaster Management – Scope and Limitations
articles.description: The role of AI in Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) is transformative, offering advanced tools for risk analysis, event prediction, and emergency response.

articles.description: Yemen Al-Khair Foundation for Relief and Development is a national humanitarian and development organization committed to supporting vulnerable populations affected by conflict, displacement, natural hazards, and socio-economic challenges across Yemen.

articles.title: Harmful information in disasters: Risk communication for safer decisions (Guidance note)
articles.description: This guidance note outlines practical approaches to strengthening information integrity within risk communication–before, during, and after disasters. Preparing for and managing information risks is an integral part of disaster risk reduction efforts.
